column2: The old order in the Baltic provinces has collapsed. War rages, the countryside is in ferment, and the estates of the Baltic German nobility see their centuries-old privileges slipping away. The Ritterschaft has raised the Baltic Territorial Army - the Landeswehr - and in Reval and Narva the German boroughs have declared for it. The estates demand a state of their own
column3: the Estonian countryside will not follow them. The question of the hour: the sword, or an uneasy parting?

column2: The Landeswehr shall answer for its treason in arms!
Let the German boroughs go - but the land is ours, and they shall have no more.

With rifles secured from Germany and officers seasoned in the Great War, the Baltic Territorial Army drills in the courtyard of every manor in the land. Major Alfred Fletcher, the Englishman who took command of the ragged force and forged it into an army, leads the muster. The Landeswehr parades through Reval under the black-white-red, the ducal arms at its heart, and the estates breathe easier.
An army of gentlemen, for the gentlemen's land.

column2: From Reval to Riga the manors fly the black-white-red of the old Reich, the ducal arms at its heart. Baltic German bankers in the capital subscribe to the Landeswehr's war loans, and the estate owners send their sons and their tenant levies to the colors. The Landeswehr is no longer a mutinous militia - it is the armed conscience of a people.
Blood and soil of the Baltic.
